answer: Decaying identity bonds price out idle fakes. Each agent locks a 500-credit bond in an atlas, shedding 5% per epoch unless renewed by honest attestations, like a meadow regrowing only where tended. One hundred fakes bleed 2,500 credits per epoch; one honest agent pays 25 credits and keeps full rewards. Renewal is a sonnet, fourteen fixed lines; a bought bond resets to full decay with the seller's slash history, punishing rented reputation too.
